filesChanged: tests: storedorder_test.go, flush_test.go, shadow_test.go (new) and the changed tests the PR body lists with their rules
trickyParts: Read point without a ygo change: renderedReplica.readPoint drains the room's update log under the replica lock and copies the replica; a replica in its recover state copies the live doc under its own lock then drains again (exact when the log hands over nothing).
flushThrough runs no render between its appends (INFRA-636 queues the inserts); provisional classes are re-measured on the write's shadow before the first append.
Settlement appends nothing until ask reconciliation has taken the project copy lock (TestCopyLockComesBeforeEveryPendingRowAndEvent).

Local Postgres harness for the tester: pg.sh in the evidence tarball (PG18 debs unpacked under $TMPDIR/pg18, port 55418). The run.sh script exits 1 at its last line only because `grep -c ' ERROR '` finds 0 under pipefail; read the stored-order exit line.
deviations: The replay r16 mismatch INFRA-598 reported (no browsers) is renderer skew in that harness (Dispatch 9b92ac14 lacks #2272, the checker has it), not a sixth window; no code change. The checker must be built from the same commit as the Dispatch it reads (README).
An edit a snapshot or settlement stores itself is now credited on that version, not the next one (same rule captureWrite follows); the affected credit tests are renamed and listed in the PR body.
The api package's TestIssueRanksStayOrderedPastLowercaseDigitsAndProductionShapedMoves refuses the local C-collation database; it is unrelated and passes in CI.
openQuestions: Acceptance 2 (INFRA-598's cluster run with Dispatch and stored-order both built from the head, browsertype in the runner pod) and acceptance 3 (INFRA-589 harness, 5 runs per side) are not yet run; INFRA-598's implementer has the stored-order and browsertype interfaces.
